github.com/egoist/mygo v0.10.0
Upstream commit ebde9399baf2734b3361856a53f4036859973d1d.
The native UI, editor, rich text, Markdown and chart packages and their renderer
dependencies are copied from this commit. Tests and examples remain upstream.
The ui/editor package includes upstream changes through f098a223fcbccfb2ce772f8d12f171f1b79c5c7a
for native block layout and caret geometry. Local changes preserve original source bytes,
project editable Markdown and direct edit commands to focused native controls.
Other local changes support document groups, workspace lifecycle and loading WebKit
on macOS only when an application requests a web feature.
See docs/mygo-document-groups.md.
